subject: Renewal: compliance roadmap, retention window + burst capacity proposal
messages:
From: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
To: sai.patel@olivebank.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 05 Nov 2025 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal: compliance roadmap, retention window + burst capacity proposal

Hi Sai —

Thanks again for the renewal conversation yesterday. Per OliveBank's ask on retention and evidentiary coverage for the SOC 2 recert, I wanted to outline a lightweight plan we can include in the renewal amendment and call out capacity options for the next 12 months. High level: 

- Retention: standard 12 months -> proposed 24 months (audit window increase)
- Evidence handoff: staggered export with weekly packages during the sprint week (we'll provide an evidence manifest CSV)
- Burst capacity: optional 30% short-term burst across Q1 to support reingestion/forensic export work
- Pricing: incremental monthly seat/retention uplift or one-time amendment credit (I can loop pricing in a follow-up)

Can you confirm the OliveBank audit window requirement (24 vs 36 months) and whether Procurement should be on the amendment threads? If 24 months works, we'll prepare a short amendment (DocuSign link) and a SOC2 bridge doc that maps evidence artifacts to the audit sections.

I can also schedule a 30-min sync with our compliance ops and your security contacts this week.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment(s): none in this message
From: Sai Patel <sai.patel@olivebank.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@olivebank.com
Date: Wed, 05 Nov 2025 11:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal: compliance roadmap, retention window + burst capacity proposal

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks for the clear outline. A couple of quick items from our side: 

1) Audit retention: OliveBank's compliance team is asking for a 24-month retention by default, but we may request a 36-month carveout for specific classes of logs (transaction metadata) — I'll confirm by EOD.
2) Procurement: please include procurement@olivebank.com on the amendment so they can process the change order and handle PO details.
3) Evidence format: can you confirm the manifest CSV schema and whether exported logs will be S3-compatible bundles or a secure transfer via FTPS?

If you can send the SOC2-bridge doc and the manifest sample, procurement will be able to do a quick review. Also please put any pricing scenarios (monthly incremental vs one-time credit) in the DocuSign statement so we can route it internally.

Sai
Sai Patel
Director of IT Risk & Compliance, OliveBank
sapatel@olivebank.com

Subject: Fwd: Renewal: compliance roadmap, retention window + burst capacity proposal

Jasmine / Kimberly — forwarding Sai's reply. Draft pricing thoughts below before we send the amendment: 

- Retention uplift 12 -> 24 months: +$1,500/mo (covers storage + expedited export SLA for audit weeks)
- 36-month carveout for transaction metadata: one-time addendum fee $4,200 (covers archival/hot-cold handling)
- Burst capacity (30% for 6 weeks): $6,000 one-time top-up credit or optional monthly overage rate 30% on committed throughput

I recommend we offer two options in DocuSign: (A) 24-month standard + burst credit one-time, (B) 36-month selective carveout (higher one-time fee) for customers who confirm they need the extended horizon. Procurement usually prefers the single amendment with both options so they can route to legal/accounting quickly.

Attachments: pricing_sheet_v2.xlsx (I'll add to the drive), sample_manifest_schema.csv (schema fields: artifact_id, artifact_type, start_ts, end_ts, s3_path_or_checksum)

—Ben

Sai / Procurement team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per Ben's note below, attached are the SOC2 bridge doc and the manifest sample schema (see evidence_manifest.csv). I've also uploaded the pricing sheet and a short amendment draft to the shared drive. Summary of asks & next steps: 

1) Retention confirmation: please confirm whether OliveBank wants a 24-month standard retention or the 36-month transaction metadata carveout. If you confirm 24 months, we will proceed with amendment option A.
2) Evidence delivery: exported bundles will be S3-compatible (we'll share pre-signed links to an S3 staging bucket and a checksum-backed manifest). If FTPS is required, we can provision secure FTPS for the sprint week — let us know.
3) Burst capacity: offer is a one-time credit ($6,000) applied at amendment execution; or we can enable burst billing by usage if you prefer recurring overage.
4) DocuSign: I placed a two-option amendment in DocuSign (link below) — please have Procurement sign the option you prefer.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/Amendment/DEAL-4820
Drive (SOC2 bridge + pricing): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB3qExampleSharedDrive
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DEAL-4820

If Procurement wants a short internal webinar to review the amendment and the manifest schema, Ben and I can host 20 minutes tomorrow morning. Please advise on a time.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
